scope: Official VALORANT terminology audit for the English UI. Source IDs disambiguate aliases; app-specific names are editorial translations.

notes: The project gunGhost audio preset uses 幽灵; the buy menu uses 鬼魅. Both mean Ghost.
The newer Bandit is on Riot's current arsenal but is absent from this project's weapon list; translation does not require adding it.
For generic explanatory prose, pistols and machine guns are fine; use Sidearms and Heavies for matching arsenal category labels.
KAY/O must keep slash and uppercase spelling.
零 means Cypher only in the agent-name context. It also appears in zero-star results and ordinary numeric text.
The same source code uses both 钢索 and 钢锁 for Deadlock.
Use official single map names rather than translating the Chinese descriptive name literally.
The （复刻） suffix describes the application's map recreation and is not part of an official map name. Suggested rendering: (Recreation).
Killjoy's ultimate is Lockdown; its status effect is detained/detain, not bound or rooted.
Flashpoint is Breach's named ability. The editor's 闪光站点 is a generic Flash Waypoint/Flash Point; avoid confusing it with Breach's ability.

Agent pages render only their initially selected ability in plain HTML. Patch 9.10 directly names Flashpoint, Guiding Light and Tailwind; patch 10.09 directly names Lockdown. Curveball is spelled as one word in Riot's older patch notes, although some newer editorial text uses Curve Ball.
Primary, Aim Down Sights, and Sniper Scope are Riot's exact Crosshair tab labels (patch 5.04). In standalone prose use primary crosshair and ADS crosshair for clarity.
连发 can mean continuous automatic fire as well as a short burst. Translate contextually: weapon fire over a held trigger is automatic fire, not necessarily burst fire.
弹道 can refer to trajectories, spread, or recoil pattern in this application. Do not map all occurrences to ballistics.
Ayakashi, Primordium and Rogue trailer titles/URLs were verified in the official playvalorant.com category page's __NEXT_DATA__ article metadata.

ORA by OneTap is already English in catalog.json. Its supplied referencePage is a community wiki; do not describe wiki.playvalorant.com as Riot-authored documentation. The wiki explicitly says it is not owned or operated by Riot.

ORA theme keys base/watch/renegade/raja/ignition should stay stable. The wiki displays Base (my lawyer said don't), Watch, RENEGADE, RAJA, Ignition; publisher-primary theme-label confirmation was not recovered, so preserve existing project labels rather than claiming new official names.
Use Kill Banner for 击杀横幅 (Riot patch 10.09 uses this exact term); finisher is a distinct last-kill effect.

criticalPitfalls: Do not translate Chinese strings by blindly replacing words in the rendered DOM: 零 is also zero, 幽灵 can be a descriptive word, and narrow weapon aliases appear inside prose.
Editor object name 全面封锁 must remain Lockdown. Flash Station/Waypoint is an app editor construct, whereas Flashpoint is a specific Breach ability.

The app uses 急停 for both the training category and release-key deceleration; counter-strafing specifically means using opposite movement input. Use stop/decelerate where that is the actual described behavior.
Do not translate the workshop/editor as an official Riot mode or brand. These are app-specific features.
Skin catalog names and runtime IDs are already in English; localize labels while preserving keys and filenames.
Traditional or mainland Chinese alternatives in the same bundle must collapse to the same canonical English game name, but only in the relevant context.

contextualCases.零: Cypher in agent and bundled scene labels; 0 in the group counter by source context
contextualCases.一: 1 in numeral helper; Mon in calendar weekday properties
contextualCases.超凡: Immortal, based on internal rank ID
contextualCases.神话: Radiant, based on internal rank ID
contextualCases.赋能: Ascendant, based on internal rank ID
